items.title: Israel has invaded deeper into Lebanon using this river crossing
items.description: Images of the first tanks to roll over Lebanon's Litani River were posted online this week. ABC NEWS Verify has found the spot where Israel's military crossed.

items.title: Government accused of misleading public on NDIS cuts
items.description: The federal government has been accused of selling its cuts to the National Disability Insurance Scheme (NDIS) as a crackdown on fraud, while instead pursuing billions of dollars of dramatic savings by slashing participant packages.

items.title: Live: Budget an attempt to combat 'economic dislocation', PM to tell summit
items.description: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese is expected to tell a summit today that the federal government's budget measures are an attempt to push back against "economic dislocation".

items.title: Town in shock after couple stabbed and alleged intruder shot
items.description: The Torrington community will meet to discuss security measures following an alleged home invasion and a couple's stabbing.

items.title: Debate over house prices 'invokes terror' in politicians
items.description: Politicians have been hesitant to say whether prices should rise or fall, as both sides of politics feel the pressure of trying to appease voters who own and voters who are trying to buy.

items.title: Women say getting a long-acting reversible contraceptive has been the 'best decision'
items.description: Misinformation, cost and a lack of trained providers have stopped many Australian women from accessing what doctors consider the most effective form of reversible contraception.

items.title: Emissions drop again, fuelling hopes Australia's hit a tipping point
items.description: Emissions are at their lowest point since the COVID pandemic shut down the economy, dropping 2.1 per cent over the year to December 2025.

items.title: China warns Australia 55pc beef tariffs could apply within days
items.description: China is cracking down on beef imports and says it is ready to slap Australia with an additional 55 per cent tariff in the coming days.

items.title: Doctor in tears over 'atypical' moles as social media craze causes concern
items.description: Skin specialists are sounding a warning about the potential cancer risks associated with unregulated peptides at the heart of a social media-driven beauty craze.

items.title: Rumours, rifts and a reported resignation form a murky picture of a war-ravaged Iran
items.description: A report about the resignation of Iran's president earlier this week came at a turbulent moment for Iran's regime, which is grappling with frictions between moderates and hardliners as the war drags on.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
